rationale: Asmita's deep expertise in post-training, alignment, and responsible AI could directly support SymbyAI's mission to automate experimental validation at scale—a problem that requires both rigorous ML infrastructure and ethical AI practices. Ashia is explicitly looking to connect with R&D and research deployment experts, and Asmita's background spanning AI research at NVIDIA, Google, and Cisco, combined with her conviction around responsible AI, positions her as a valuable technical advisor or potential collaborator for building trustworthy AI-driven research workflows.
intro_message: Asmita Hajra, meet Ashia Livaudais—she's building SymbyAI to automate experimental validation and combat research waste, and your expertise in LLM post-training and responsible AI could be exactly what her research infrastructure needs.
